gate_coverage: Actual holdout input is rejected by a native rules diagnostic child before creation of any attempt directory; no extraction/inference occurs.
Modified development source with the same three IDs is rejected by byte hash.
Native freeze/verify/summarize execute argument guards through macOS temporary-directory path aliases and return failure for invalid options.
Complete synthetic three-backend development binding passes; altered messages, wrong IDs/input hashes and disguised formal protocols fail.
Freeze refuses an existing formal attempt directory and refuses to overwrite an existing freeze; diagnostics close after freezing.
Existing output directory bytes are preserved and never overwritten.
Prior failed or stopped attempts reserve their complete planned messages, including cases without returned results.
An existing atomic budget lock prevents a new DeepSeek attempt and remains for reconciliation.
The entire next batch must fit under the cumulative 2 USD reservation before an attempt is created; a rejected budget check releases its own lock.

closed_findings.finding: Diagnostic mode originally admitted arbitrary small inputs before freezing, allowing a misrouted holdout to be processed without the formal gate.
closed_findings.resolution: Exact preregistered development byte identity, IDs/messages checks and pre-freeze directory checks now prevent this path; native negative probes pass.

closed_findings.finding: freeze/verify/summarize compared raw module URLs with argv paths, so macOS /var to /private/var aliases silently returned success without executing a CLI.
closed_findings.resolution: Shared realpath-based main-module detection now executes all three CLI guards; three native before-red/after-green tests are permanent.

limits: This review executes no model, Worker, network request, training or deployment and reads no model candidate response.
Temporary fixtures include explicit synthetic receipts for gate behavior; they are not evidence that real backend development or formal evaluation has completed.

The runner intentionally fails closed if another backend initialization exposes a directory before protocol.json exists; serialize initialization, then different initialized backends may run concurrently. A root-recorded zero-send failure receipt is retained; this reviewer did not replay live initialization.
The positive real experiment freeze/preflight, final integrated check and result recomputation remain separate parent-coordinated evidence.
Source labels remain non-expert provisional technical annotations, not legal or real-case accuracy certification.
Receipt applies to the exact listed hashes; subsequent changes need their effect reviewed.

known_startup_boundary.cause: A concurrent other-backend mkdir can become visible before its protocol receipt is written; budget scan rejects ENOENT before creating the new DeepSeek attempt.
known_startup_boundary.safe_operation: Finish each backend initialization and protocol write serially; initialized backends can then run concurrently.
known_startup_boundary.root_resolution: Start the first DeepSeek development attempt after the existing Qwen protocol receipt is present; no model retry.
